sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Here's a trick.
sentences.zh: 这里有个小窍门。

sentences.en: If you want to design a good flag, a kick-ass flag like Chicago's or DC's,
sentences.zh: 如果你想设计一面好旗帜，一面像芝加哥或华盛顿特区那样酷毙了的旗帜，

sentences.en: start by drawing a 1x1.5 inch rectangle on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 先在纸上画一个1乘1.5英寸的矩形。

sentences.en: Your design has to work within that tiny rectangle.
sentences.zh: 你的设计必须在这个小矩形内发挥作用。

sentences.en: Here's why.
sentences.zh: 原因如下。

sentences.en: A 3x5 foot flag on a pole 100 feet away looks about the same size as a 1x1.5 inch rectangle seen about 15 inches from your eye.
sentences.zh: 一面3乘5英尺的旗帜在100英尺外看起来，和在离眼睛约15英寸处看到的1乘1.5英寸矩形大小差不多。

sentences.en: So instead of starting with a big canvas or a wide cinema display,
sentences.zh: 所以，与其从一张大画布或宽屏电影显示器开始，

sentences.en: try drawing your flag on a rectangle that's 1x1.5 inches.
sentences.zh: 不如试着在1乘1.5英寸的矩形上画你的旗帜。

sentences.en: You'll be surprised at how compelling and simple the design can be when you hold yourself to that limitation.
sentences.zh: 当你把自己限制在这个范围内时，你会惊讶于设计竟能如此引人注目且简洁。

sentences.en: That, my friends, is Ted Kay.
sentences.zh: 朋友们，那位就是泰德·凯。

sentences.en: Ted Kay.
sentences.zh: 泰德·凯。

sentences.en: I live here in Portland, Oregon, and I'm involved in the study of flags.
sentences.zh: 我住在俄勒冈州的波特兰，我参与了旗帜研究。

sentences.en: When I went to his house in Portland, he flew the San Francisco flag out front in honor of my visit.
sentences.zh: 当我去他在波特兰的家时，为了表示对我的尊重，他在门前升起了旧金山市的旗帜。

sentences.en: That's the kind of guy Ted Kay is.
sentences.zh: 泰德·凯就是这样的人。

sentences.en: I'm involved with the Portland Flag Association.
sentences.zh: 我参与了波特兰旗帜协会的工作。

sentences.en: We're a loosely organized group of people interested in flags,
sentences.zh: 我们是一个松散的组织，由对旗帜感兴趣的人组成，

sentences.en: and we are the largest subnational flag organization in the country with the largest membership.
sentences.zh: 我们是全国最大的地方性旗帜组织，拥有最多的会员。

sentences.en: Around 25 dues-paying members.
sentences.zh: 大约有25名缴纳会费的会员。

sentences.en: The most frequent meeting, schedule, and the greatest amount of publishing.
sentences.zh: 我们有最频繁的会议、日程安排和最多的出版物。

sentences.en: Unlike a lot of his fellow vexillologists, that's a person who studies flags,
sentences.zh: 和许多研究旗帜的旗帜学家不同，

sentences.en: Ted is especially interested in flag design.
sentences.zh: 泰德对旗帜设计特别感兴趣。

sentences.en: Many other vexillologists are more focused on history, protocol, and usage.
sentences.zh: 许多其他旗帜学家更关注历史、礼仪和使用规范。

sentences.en: There's one school of thought that says we are flag scholars,
sentences.zh: 有一种观点认为我们是旗帜学者，

sentences.en: and every flag is equally appropriate to study,
sentences.zh: 每一面旗帜都同样值得研究，

sentences.en: and whether we like the design or not is immaterial.
sentences.zh: 至于我们是否喜欢这个设计并不重要。

sentences.en: We should be dispassionate scholars.
sentences.zh: 我们应该做冷静客观的学者。

sentences.en: But then there are people in the second group, like Ted, and me at this point, actually,
sentences.zh: 但还有第二类人，比如泰德，还有现在的我，

sentences.en: who love beautiful flags and go out in the world and lobby for better ones.
sentences.zh: 他们热爱美丽的旗帜，并走向世界，游说人们采用更好的设计。

sentences.en: Those who are in the second camp have identified a name for those people,
sentences.zh: 那些属于第二阵营的人为自己起了一个名字，

sentences.en: and that's a vexillinaire, an activist vexillologiSt.
sentences.zh: 那就是“旗帜狂热者”，即激进的旗帜学家。

sentences.en: If you've listened to this show for a very, very long time, you know
sentences.zh: 如果你听这个节目已经很久很久了，你就会知道

sentences.en: that when it comes to designing flags, there are rules.
sentences.zh: 在设计旗帜时，是有规则可循的。

sentences.en: The principles being keep it simple, use meaningful symbolism,
sentences.zh: 原则是保持简洁，使用有意义的象征符号，

sentences.en: use two to three basic colors, no lettering or seals, and be distinctive.
sentences.zh: 使用两到三种基本颜色，不要有文字或印章，并且要具有独特性。

sentences.en: All the best flags tend to stick to these principles, but one rule, the fourth one.
sentences.zh: 所有最好的旗帜往往都遵循这些原则，但有一条规则，即第四条，

sentences.en: No lettering or seals.
sentences.zh: 不要有文字或印章。

sentences.en: That rule, for some reason, Americans just can't grasp.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，美国人就是无法理解这条规则。

sentences.en: We have tons of flags with writing and municipal seals on them, and that's bad.
sentences.zh: 我们有大量的旗帜上面写着字并印有市政印章，这很糟糕。

sentences.en: Here's why you shouldn't have a seal on a flag.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么旗帜上不应该有印章的原因。

sentences.en: A seal is designed to be on a piece of paper,
sentences.zh: 印章是设计在纸上使用的，

sentences.en: to be seen close up, to be seen flat, not moving, and on only one side of the paper.
sentences.zh: 为了近距离观看，为了平放观看，不会移动，而且只印在纸的一面。

sentences.en: A flag is meant to be seen from a distance on a piece of fabric that's moving
sentences.zh: 旗帜是为了在远处观看，印在会飘动的织物上，

sentences.en: and might be seen on the front or the back.
sentences.zh: 而且可能会从正面或背面看到。

sentences.en: Seals don't belong on flags.
sentences.zh: 印章不属于旗帜。

sentences.en: Seals belong on pieces of paper.
sentences.zh: 印章属于纸张。

sentences.en: Damn right.
sentences.zh: 说得太对了。

sentences.en: One of the intriguing things about the fact that TED-K
sentences.zh: 关于泰德·凯

sentences.en: and the largest subnational flag organization are both based in Portland
sentences.zh: 和最大的地方性旗帜组织都位于波特兰这一事实，其中一件有趣的事情是，

sentences.en: is that Portland didn't have an official flag for the first 100 years of its existence.
sentences.zh: 波特兰在建市的前100年里并没有正式的旗帜。

sentences.en: Portland had several flags that had been proposed and not officially adopted,
sentences.zh: 波特兰曾有几面被提议但未被正式采用的旗帜，

sentences.en: even though people thought they'd been adopted.
sentences.zh: 尽管人们以为它们已经被采用了。

sentences.en: But that was about to change in 1969.
sentences.zh: 但这种情况在1969年即将改变。

sentences.en: A group proposed a flag to the city.
sentences.zh: 一个团体向市政府提议了一面旗帜。

sentences.en: The group was the Commercial Club of Portland.
sentences.zh: 这个团体是波特兰商业俱乐部。

sentences.en: The proposed design consisted of a white field,
sentences.zh: 提议的设计包括一个白色的底色，

sentences.en: that's the background color,
sentences.zh: 也就是背景色，

sentences.en: with a city seal in gold in the center,
sentences.zh: 中间有一个金色的城市印章，

sentences.en: flanked by two red roses on either side,
sentences.zh: 两侧各有一朵红玫瑰，

sentences.en: and then the words,
sentences.zh: 然后是文字，

sentences.en: World Port of the Pacific on top,
sentences.zh: 上方写着“太平洋世界港口”，

sentences.en: City of Roses below.
sentences.zh: 下方写着“玫瑰之城”。

sentences.en: I'm going to have to go lie down.
sentences.zh: 我得去躺一会儿了。

sentences.en: And Mayor Terry Shrunk,
sentences.zh: 而特里·什伦克市长，

sentences.en: who was a very astute politician,
sentences.zh: 他是一位非常精明的政治家，

sentences.en: looked at this design and said,
sentences.zh: 看了这个设计后说，

sentences.en: I'm not capable of deciding on a flag design for the city of Portland.
sentences.zh: 我没有能力为波特兰市决定旗帜设计。

sentences.en: This is a job for the Portland Arts Commission.
sentences.zh: 这是波特兰艺术委员会的工作。

sentences.en: Smart guy indeed.
sentences.zh: 真是个聪明人。

sentences.en: But this decision set into motion one of the greatest tragedies and redemptions in vexillogical history.
sentences.zh: 但这个决定开启了旗帜学史上最伟大的悲剧与救赎之一。

sentences.en: The Arts Commission selected an esteemed local artist named Doug Lynch to create a brand new design.
sentences.zh: 艺术委员会选择了一位受人尊敬的当地艺术家道格·林奇来创作一个全新的设计。

sentences.en: He was a prominent graphic designer.
sentences.zh: 他是一位杰出的平面设计师。

sentences.en: They called him a commercial artist at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时他们称他为商业艺术家。

sentences.en: So Doug Lynch created a questionnaire,
sentences.zh: 于是道格·林奇制作了一份问卷，

sentences.en: asking both the city council and the Arts Commission which attributes should be on the flag.
sentences.zh: 询问市议会和艺术委员会旗帜上应该具备哪些属性。

sentences.en: As you might expect, the members of the city council had a different view of what a flag should look like
sentences.zh: 正如你所料，市议会成员对旗帜应该是什么样子有着不同的看法，

sentences.en: from what the Arts Commission members looked like.
sentences.zh: 与艺术委员会成员的看法截然不同。

sentences.en: You don't say.
sentences.zh: 可不是嘛。

sentences.en: The city commissioners were, they wanted realism.
sentences.zh: 市议员们想要的是写实主义。

sentences.en: They wanted the name of the city on the flag.
sentences.zh: 他们想要在旗帜上写上城市的名字。

sentences.en: They wanted a rose.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一朵玫瑰。

sentences.en: They wanted a mountain.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一座山。

sentences.en: They wanted lots of stuff on the flag.
sentences.zh: 他们想在旗帜上放很多东西。

sentences.en: The arts commissioners said it should be abstract.
sentences.zh: 艺术委员们则说它应该是抽象的。

sentences.en: It shouldn't have words on it.
sentences.zh: 上面不应该有文字。

sentences.en: Much more consistent with our modern perception of what good flag design is.
sentences.zh: 这与我们现代对什么是好旗帜设计的认知更为一致。

sentences.en: So Doug went into the fray and designed a flag that did not have a rose on it,
sentences.zh: 于是道格投入了这场争论，设计了一面没有玫瑰的旗帜，

sentences.en: did not have the name of the city on it.
sentences.zh: 上面也没有城市的名字。

sentences.en: It was an abstract design.
sentences.zh: 这是一个抽象的设计。

sentences.en: Doug's design was a, I would call it an offset cross.
sentences.zh: 道格的设计是，我会称之为偏移的十字。

sentences.en: If you go to our website or pull out your phone,
sentences.zh: 如果你去我们的网站或拿出手机，

sentences.en: you'll see a variation of this flag that Doug Lynch proposed.
sentences.zh: 你会看到道格·林奇提议的这面旗帜的变体。

sentences.en: It's incorporated into the cover tile of this episode.
sentences.zh: 它被整合到了这一集的封面图中。

sentences.en: Two lines crossing from top to bottom and left to right in the center,
sentences.zh: 两条线在中心从上到下、从左到右交叉，

sentences.en: creating a void in the center that is called a hypocycloid, a four-pointed star.
sentences.zh: 在中心形成了一个空隙，被称为次摆线，即一颗四角星。

sentences.en: The blue lines that crossed represented the confluence of the Columbia and Willamette rivers.
sentences.zh: 交叉的蓝色线条代表了哥伦比亚河和威拉米特河的汇合处。

sentences.en: The white hypocycloid represented the city of Portland at their confluence.
sentences.zh: 白色的次摆线代表了位于汇合处的波特兰市。

sentences.en: And then those stripes were bordered by yellow stripes, gold stripes,
sentences.zh: 然后这些条纹被黄色的条纹、金色的条纹所包围，

sentences.en: which represented either commerce or grain flowing along the rivers.
sentences.zh: 这代表了沿着河流流动的商业或谷物。

sentences.en: And everything was on a background of green representing the forests.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都在代表森林的绿色背景上。

sentences.en: It's really lovely.
sentences.zh: 真的很可爱。

sentences.en: City council said, thank you for your design,
sentences.zh: 市议会说，谢谢你的设计，

sentences.en: and changed the upper left-hand corner from green to blue and put the city seal on it.
sentences.zh: 然后把左上角从绿色改成了蓝色，并把城市印章放在了上面。

sentences.en: And adopted that flag.
sentences.zh: 并采用了那面旗帜。

sentences.en: I know all the graphic designers in the audience are digging half-moon-shaped scars
sentences.zh: 我知道在场的平面设计师们听到这种亵渎行为时，都在手掌心掐出了半月形的伤痕。

sentences.en: in the meat of their palms upon hearing this violation.
sentences.zh: 更令人痛苦的是，这个怪物离成为一面真正的好旗帜如此之近，

sentences.en: It's almost more painful that this abomination was so close to being a really good flag,
sentences.zh: 就是道格·林奇最初提交的那一面。

sentences.en: the one that Doug Lynch had originally submitted.
sentences.zh: 过了几年，市议会版本的旗帜在1973年开始流通。

sentences.en: It took a few years, but the city council version of the flag made it out into circulation in 1973.
sentences.zh: 但由于它是一个相对糟糕的设计，上面还有那个城市印章，

sentences.en: But being a relatively poor design with that city seal on it,
sentences.zh: 大多数人甚至看不出那是城市印章。

sentences.en: most people can't tell it's the city seal even.
sentences.zh: 它就像蓝色背景上的一团黄金色斑点。

sentences.en: It's kind of a yellow gold blob on blue.
sentences.zh: 这面旗帜从未被广泛悬挂。

sentences.en: The flag was never widely flown.
sentences.zh: 所以近30年后，道格·林奇加入了波特兰旗帜协会。

sentences.en: So nearly 30 years later, Doug Lynch joined the Portland Flag Association.
sentences.zh: 他当时80多岁，我邀请他参加我们的一次会议，

sentences.en: He was in his late 80s, and I invited him to come to one of our meetings
sentences.zh: 解释他设计这面旗帜的整个故事，

sentences.en: and explain this whole story of how he had designed the flag
sentences.zh: 它是如何被采用的，以及它是如何在最后一刻被修改的。

sentences.en: and how it was adopted and how it was changed at the last minute.
sentences.zh: 在演讲结束时，道格说，

sentences.en: And at the end of the presentation, Doug said,
sentences.zh: 如果我能重来一次，我会加宽蓝色条纹，

sentences.en: if I had to do it over again, I would widen the blue stripes,
sentences.zh: 把旗帜的中心稍微移动一下，

sentences.en: move the center of the flag over a little,
sentences.zh: 把那个蓝色的左上角改回绿色。

sentences.en: take that upper left-hand corner, which is blue, and change it back to green.
sentences.zh: 他会把那个城市印章从旗帜上拿掉。

sentences.en: And he would take that city seal off the flag.
sentences.zh: 我会做出所有这些改动。

sentences.en: I would make all those.
sentences.zh: 这就是我会设计旗帜的方式。

sentences.en: That's how I would do the flag.
sentences.zh: 但已经过去30年了。

sentences.en: But it's been 30 years.
sentences.zh: 现在太晚了。

sentences.en: It's too late now.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哇，哇，哇，等等，等一下。

sentences.en: And they're like, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 我们是全国最大的地方性旗帜组织。

sentences.en: We're the largest subnational flag organization in the country.
sentences.zh: 听着，道格，还不晚。

sentences.en: Look, Doug, it's not too late.
sentences.zh: 坐在桌子旁的人包括写过波特兰市旗历史的人，

sentences.en: Sitting around the table are the person who has written the history of the flag of the city of Portland,
sentences.zh: 写过旗帜设计指南的人，

sentences.en: the person who's written the guidebook on flag design,
sentences.zh: 实际制造这些旗帜的人，

sentences.en: the person who actually manufactures those flags,
sentences.zh: 以及设计了它的人。

sentences.en: and you who designed it.
sentences.zh: 我们应该能把它改过来。

sentences.en: We ought to be able to get this changed.
sentences.zh: 在未来的波特兰市长萨姆·亚当斯的帮助下，

sentences.en: And with the help of future Portland Mayor Sam Adams,
sentences.zh: 他们向市议会提交了一项更新旗帜的法令。

sentences.en: they presented an ordinance to the city council to update the flag.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子梅森，他写过波特兰市旗的历史，他作了证。

sentences.en: My son Mason, who had written the history of the city flags of Portland, testified.
sentences.zh: 我作了证。

sentences.en: I testified.
sentences.zh: 迈克·黑尔，他是埃尔默旗帜与横幅公司的老板，

sentences.en: Mike Hale, who was the owner of Elmer's Flag and Banner,
sentences.zh: 也就是制造这面旗帜的人，他作了证。

sentences.en: who manufactured it, testified.
sentences.zh: 道格·林奇也作了证。

sentences.en: And Doug Lynch testified.
sentences.zh: 道格是波特兰设计界受人尊敬的人物。

sentences.en: And Doug was a revered figure in design in Portland.
sentences.zh: 委员会实际上低头说，

sentences.en: And the commission, in effect, bowed and said,
sentences.zh: 你是告诉我们这个设计应该是什么样子的合适人选。

sentences.en: you're the right person to tell us what this design ought to look like.
sentences.zh: 我们同意你的设计。

sentences.en: We agree with your design.
sentences.zh: 当时的市长维拉·卡茨说，太棒了。

sentences.en: And the mayor, Mayor Vera Katz at the time, the mayor said, that's great.
sentences.zh: 下周回来，我们会采用它，但要带一面真正的旗帜来。

sentences.en: Come back next week and we'll adopt it, but bring a real flag.
sentences.zh: 你能做到吗？

sentences.en: Can you do that?
sentences.zh: 旗帜公司的老板迈克·黑尔咽了口唾沫说，是的，我们可以做到。

sentences.en: And Mike Hale, owner of the flag company, gulped and said, yes, we can do that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们可以做到。

sentences.en: And so the next week, he'd had his seamstresses sew up a new city of Portland flag.
sentences.zh: 于是接下来的一周，他让裁缝缝制了一面新的波特兰市旗。

sentences.en: We came to the city council hearing.
sentences.zh: 我们参加了市议会的听证会。

sentences.en: The council held a vote on the ordinance, 5 to 0.
sentences.zh: 议会以5比0的投票结果通过了该条例。

sentences.en: They adopted the flag.
sentences.zh: 他们采纳了这面旗帜。

sentences.en: And Mayor Katz said, pointing to the old flag on the flagpole,
sentences.zh: 卡茨市长指着旗杆上的旧旗帜说：

sentences.en: take that down and put it in archives.
sentences.zh: 把它取下来，放进档案馆。

sentences.en: Can you put that new flag up?
sentences.zh: 你能把那面新旗帜升上去吗？

sentences.en: And so one of our members, John Hood,
sentences.zh: 于是我们的一位成员约翰·胡德，

sentences.en: went over and put the flag on the flagpole in the city council chambers,
sentences.zh: 走过去把旗帜挂在了市议会大厅的旗杆上，

sentences.en: being the first one to raise the official city of Portland flag.
sentences.zh: 成为了第一个升起波特兰官方市旗的人。

sentences.en: The correct city of Portland flag.
sentences.zh: 那面正确的波特兰市旗。

sentences.en: This current flag, with all the updates that Doug Lynch wanted,
sentences.zh: 这面现行的旗帜，包含了道格·林奇想要的所有更新，

sentences.en: is the graphic that's on the front of the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 就是播客封面上展示的那个图案。

sentences.en: If you haven't done so already, pull it out.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没看过，把它拿出来看看。

sentences.en: Have a look.
sentences.zh: 看一眼。

sentences.en: It's handsome.
sentences.zh: 它很漂亮。

sentences.en: It's a good flag.
sentences.zh: 这是一面好旗帜。

sentences.en: Best of all, people in Portland actually use it,
sentences.zh: 最棒的是，波特兰人真的在使用它，

sentences.en: especially if you go to a soccer game.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在你去观看足球比赛的时候。

sentences.en: If you don't see your city flag anywhere in your hometown,
sentences.zh: 如果你在自己的家乡到处都看不到市旗，

sentences.en: maybe it needs a redesign too.
sentences.zh: 也许它也需要重新设计一下。

sentences.en: But that's just the vexling air in me talking.
sentences.zh: 但这只是我这个旗帜迷在自言自语。

sentences.en: 99% invisible is Sam Greenspan, Katie Mingle,
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》的制作团队有萨姆·格林斯潘、凯蒂·明格尔、

sentences.en: Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里·特鲁夫曼，还有我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 local public radio KALW in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7本地公共广播电台KALW的一个项目，

sentences.en: home of a very bad flag,
sentences.zh: 那里有一面非常糟糕的旗帜，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 节目是在ArcSign的办公室制作的，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California,
sentences.zh: 位于美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心，

sentences.en: home of a pretty good flag.
sentences.zh: 那里有一面相当不错的旗帜。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并点赞这个节目。

sentences.en: All of us are on Twitter, Instagram, and Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都开通了Twitter、Instagram和Spotify。

sentences.en: But to find out more about this story,
sentences.zh: 但想要了解更多关于这个故事的信息，

sentences.en: including cool pictures and links,
sentences.zh: 包括酷炫的图片和链接，

sentences.en: and listen to all the episodes of 99% Invisible,
sentences.zh: 以及收听《99%隐形》的所有剧集，

sentences.en: you must go to 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 你必须访问99pi.org。
